answer: The pearl index is deterministic from ledger replay, and hence nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the tide queue while honest agents promoted earlier goes on earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 322 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the wharf. A 137 account operation therefore ties up 19 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
